projects.title: CLI Expense Manager
projects.summary: A menu-driven console app that records expenses, groups them by category and prints monthly totals.
projects.useCase: Personal budgeting without a spreadsheet: add an expense, review category totals, spot the biggest spending area.
projects.architecture: Single-file Main with an Expense record, an ArrayList<Expense> store and a command loop. Categories are aggregated with a TreeMap at report time.

steps.title: Model and store
tasks: Create a record Expense(String category, int amount)
Keep a List<Expense> and an add command
Validate that the amount is positive

steps.title: Report
tasks: Print category=total then the grand total

requirements: Print totals with no trailing spaces
testing: Add two expenses in one category and check the total
Add a zero amount and confirm it is rejected
Report an empty store without an exception

projects.title: Student Result Portal
projects.summary: Store students and marks, compute grades, class average and the topper.
projects.useCase: A teacher needs a printable result sheet for a class of 40 students.
projects.architecture: Student class with name and marks, a ResultService holding a List<Student>, and a Main that reads input and prints a formatted table.

steps.title: Domain
tasks: Create Student with name and marks
Add a grade() method with documented boundaries

steps.title: Aggregation
tasks: Find the topper by comparing marks

steps.title: Output
tasks: Format the average to two decimals

projects.useCase: A small cooperative bank needs a console prototype before building a real service.
projects.architecture: Account objects with encapsulated balance, a Map<Integer, Account> registry, and a Transaction record appended to an in-memory log.

steps.title: Audit

projects.useCase: A school library wants to replace a paper register with a console system.

projects.useCase: A small shop needs a billing counter that also updates stock.

Apply an 18% tax and round to 2 decimals

projects.title: Contact Manager with File Persistence
projects.summary: A contact book that survives restarts by reading and writing a CSV file.
projects.useCase: A salesperson needs a simple local address book without a database.
projects.architecture: Contact records, a CsvStore using Files.readAllLines/writeString inside try-with-resources, and a service layer for add/find/list.

steps.title: Storage
tasks: Write the whole file atomically after each change

requirements: Malformed rows skipped with a warning
No data loss on write failure
errors: Corrupting the file on a partial write

projects.title: Employee Payroll System

projects.useCase: HR needs a payroll prototype with developers, managers and interns.
projects.architecture: Abstract Employee with an abstract monthlyPay(), subclasses per role, and a Payroll service that totals and prints payslips.

projects.architecture: PriorityBlockingQueue of ScheduledTask, a fixed ExecutorService, and a dispatcher thread that releases tasks when due.
